```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(dotenv)

env_file = here(".env")
```

```{r}
SERVER_PATH <- Sys.getenv("SERVER_PATH")
```

```{r}
cdi_level1 <- read.csv(file.path(SERVER_PATH, "data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level1.csv"))
cdi_level2a <- read.csv(file.path(SERVER_PATH, "data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level2a.csv"))
words_row <- cdi_level1[1,]
#delete unnecessary columns
cdi1_cleaned <- cdi_level1 |> filter(Finished == 1) |> rename(duration_in_seconds = Duration..in.seconds.) |> select(ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
cdi2_cleaned <- cdi_level2a |> filter(Finished == 1)  |> rename(duration_in_seconds = Duration..in.seconds.) |> select(ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
```

```{r}
#get a mapping table
words <- words_row |> select(starts_with("Q")) |> pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Q")) |> separate(value, into=c('WordType', 'Words'), sep='-') |> mutate(WordType = trimws(WordType), Words = trimws(Words))
```

```{r}
# transform to pivot long for df1
cdi1_long <- cdi1_cleaned |> pivot_longer(cols=!ChildID, names_to = "Question", values_to = 'Response') |> mutate(Response = trimws(Response), Response = na_if(Response, ""), Response = as.numeric(Response)) |>
  #add survey type and value
  mutate(SurveyType = 1,
         Value = ifelse(is.na(Response), 0, 1))
```

```{r}
#check before merge words to df1_long
setdiff(cdi1_long$Question, words$name)

#map into condition
ability <- tibble::tibble(Response = c(NA, 1, 2), Type = c(NA, 'understands', 'produc'))

#merge conditions and words
cdi1_merged <- cdi1_long %>% left_join(words, c('Question' = 'name')) |> left_join(ability, 'Response') 

# if type = produces; add type = understands row with value = 1
# if type = understands; add type = produces row with value = 0
# if type = NA ; update type = produces row with value = 0 AND type = understands row with value = 0
# maybe use fill function in R?
```

```{r}
cdi1_complete <- cdi1_merged |>
  # keep both ability types for every item
  complete(
    nesting(Question,ChildID, Words, WordType, SurveyType),
    Type = c("understands", "produces")
  ) %>%
  # fill missing values
  mutate(
    Value = case_when(
      Type == "understands" & is.na(Value) ~ 0,
      Type == "produces" & is.na(Value) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ Value
    )
  ) %>%
  # if produces == 1, understands should also == 1
  group_by(Question, ChildID) %>%
  mutate(
    Value = ifelse(
      Type == "understands" &
      any(Type == "produces" & Value == 1),
      1,
      Value
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#process df2 similar to df 1 -- TODO: fix naming etc.
df2_long <- df2 %>% pivot_longer(c(Q1, Q2, Q3), names_to = 'Question_group', values_to = 'Response') %>% separate_rows(Response, sep=',')
df2_long <- df2_long %>% mutate(Response = trimws(Response), Response = na_if(Response, ""), Response = as.numeric(Response))
```

```{r}
#get the label for df2
cdi_level2a_label <- read.csv(file.path(SERVER_PATH, "data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level2a_label.csv"))
df2_label <- cdi_level2a_label
df2_label <- df2_label %>% select(ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
df2_label <- df2_label[-c(1, 2), ]

#separate choices
df2_label <- df2_label %>% pivot_longer(c(Q1, Q2, Q3), names_to = 'Question_group', values_to = 'Words') %>% separate_rows(Words, sep=',')
#colnames(df2_label)[2] <- 'combine_words'
df2_label <- df2_label %>% mutate(Words = trimws(Words), Words = na_if(Words, ""))
```

```{r}
#create order index
nrow(df2_long) == nrow(df2_label)

num <- nrow(df2_long)
ID <- c(1:num)

df2_long <- cbind(ID, df2_long)
df2_label <- cbind(ID, df2_label)

#merge
df2_long <- df2_long %>% merge(df2_label, by='ID')
```

```{r}
#clean df2_long
df2_long$Question_group.y = NULL
df2_long$ChildID.y = NULL

colnames(df2_long)[2] <- 'ChildID'
colnames(df2_long)[3] <- 'Question_group'

#add type and value column
df2_long$SurveyType = '2A'
df2_long$Value = ifelse(is.na(df2_long$Words), 0, 1)
```
